title: Chapter 83: Breaking Out Of The Siege (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 83: Breaking Out Of The Siege (Part 2)

Wu Qing learned from Niu Kun that the Tengu clan could no longer hold on in this confrontation, and the war was expected to take place in the next two days.

Even the small lord Ushikun knew the news, which meant that the Tengu clan had reached the point where they had to go to war.

Now Wu Qing has single-handedly mobilized a large number of troops of the Evil God Army, and destroyed the most important sacrifice card of the Evil God Army. The balance of victory can be said to have tilted towards the Tengu Clan in an instant. It depends on whether the Tengu Clan can seize it. This opportunity.

When the Evil God's army was mobilized in large numbers by the Zerg tribe, Gou Hong, the elder of the Tengu tribe in charge of the affairs of the Endless Mountains branch, was presiding over a pre-war meeting in the Tengu tribe's camp.

"The scouts responsible for monitoring the Evil God's army camp came to report that for some unknown reason, the Evil God's army is mobilizing on a large scale!"

"A large number of their troops are being transferred to the rear. Some scouts have reported that they have seen multiple signal bombs rising from their rear. It is suspected that something unexpected has happened!"

The Tengu clan member in charge of intelligence work made a report.

"Let's discuss, could this be a conspiracy from the evil god camp? How should we deal with it?"

Gou Hong looked like an old man and asked slowly.

Below him were a group of senior Tengu clan officials.

But no one said anything. They all sat upright, as if they had no opinion on anything.

The scene fell into silence, and the clan elder Gou Hong was not in a hurry, and seemed to be a little sleepy.

Finally, someone couldn't bear such a scene, so he stood up, gave Gou Hong a chest-stroking salute, and said respectfully: "Elder of the clan, I think this is a good opportunity to start a war!"

"The evil god's army is mobilizing, and the frontline troops will inevitably be empty. As long as we fight steadily and don't advance rashly, even if there is a conspiracy, the impact will not be big!"

"After all, if we don't go to war now, we will have to choose to go to war tomorrow and the day after tomorrow!"

Clan elder Gou Hong didn't say anything, but some people couldn't sit still and stood up to retort: "Gou Yin, your idea is too risky!"

"Think about it, is there any force in this area that can mobilize the armies of both of us? Definitely not!"

"So, this mobilization of the evil god's army is a conspiracy!"

"Before the scouts find out the situation, we'd better not act rashly!"

Gou Yin thought for a while and then said: "I learned that one of our troops was sent to perform the task of cutting off the supply line of the evil god's army. According to reports from the personnel responsible for monitoring, their combat power is not weak."

"Could it be that they mobilized the forces of the evil god's army?"

The man looked sarcastic and said, "Are you talking about the troops sent by the so-called Independent Territory Alliance?"

"I received the news last night that they are from those independent territories. If they are sent out this time, they will die!"

"What kind of waves can they make?"

Gou Yin said: "So it was you who issued the mission? Why did you order them to die in the current situation?"

Seeing that the two were about to quarrel, the clan elder Gou Hong coughed lightly and stopped the two from continuing to talk.

"Since the opinions are not unanimous, let's wait for the news. What Gou Yin said makes sense. If this is really an opportunity, the war can start today."

Gou Hong, the elder of the tribe, settled on his words and began to close his eyes and rest his mind.

"I'll arrange for more scouts to find out the news!"

The Tengu clan member in charge of intelligence work stood up and left, and the scene fell into silence again.

…

Wu Qing passed the puppies around the Tengu Clan's camp and saw that the Tengu Clan had been silent and only sent out more scouts. His evaluation of the Tengu Clan dropped to another level.

Faced with a God-given opportunity, I dare not give it a try and have no enterprising spirit at all!

A war of this scale relies on strength! As long as you keep yourself steady and don't make too many advances, no conspiracy or trick will come to the fore!

What's more, this is still a war that has to be fought. We can't afford to delay it. If we don't dare to fight when we have the opportunity, we worry about gains and losses, and we are cautious. This shows the incompetence of the commanders.

"It's really tiring to meet such an ally!"

Wu Qing had no choice but to dispatch the surrounding puppies to clear the way for the Tengu clan's scouts, allowing those scouts to smoothly enter the battlefield area that was layered with defenses.

Without the secret clearance of the Zerg puppies, the scouts of the Tengu clan would not even be able to touch the edge of the battlefield where the Zerg are breaking out.

The Zerg army was breaking through, and three thousand Hydralisks rushed forward to face the long-armed ogre. With the personal protection of the puppy, they did not need to worry about their own safety, they only needed to attack with all their strength.

The dense spikes were fired at close range, and even the long-armed ogre's defense and physique could not withstand it. The long-range attack of three thousand hydralisks was very terrifying. The phalanx of five thousand long-armed ogres, under the hydralisk, In less than ten volleys, the entire army was wiped out.

The priest who personally commanded the bugbear infantry phalanx transformed all five thousand bugbear infantry into madness with the energy of faith!

This is a terrible force!

The mad bugbear infantry took the initiative to charge towards the Zerg!

The puppies behind the Hydralisks were no longer silent. They quickly surpassed the Hydralisks that kept advancing and shooting, and killed the mad bugbear infantry that rushed up!

Brutal melee fighting broke out, and a lot of lives were lost every second!

The Hydralisk took advantage of the height difference between the swollen bugbear infantry and the puppies after going berserk, and continued to launch continuous attacks on the berserk bugbear infantry.

More puppies rushed forward and attacked the phalanx of several other native race soldiers who had converted to the evil god.

A big melee broke out!

The human wanderers in the Zerg army had few Zerg troops around them, and nearly 20,000 Zerg troops almost all rushed forward.

With the core force of the berserk bear goblin infantry and the cooperation of the evil god believers who did not know what retreat was, the Zerg's attack encountered obstacles.

The other evil god troops around were quickly surrounding them, and the situation seemed to have reached an extremely dangerous point.

"Keep charging! Throw spears to support the front battle!"

The masked leader gave the human wanderers who had just recovered a little strength a combat order.

The battlefield was full of spears thrown by the evil god army, and the human wanderers already had a bundle of intact spears in their hands.

The one-star hydralisk possessed by Wu Qing's consciousness had been following him, and did not interfere with the masked leader's orders.

Wu Qing saw that the human wanderers' spear throwing skills were more sophisticated than the tiger cavalry of the tiger leader. Although they were all disheveled and had only some randomly pieced together leather armor on their bodies, their momentum of charging was very fierce and intimidating.

The silent human wanderers accelerated their charge and threw the javelins in their hands far away!

Two thousand javelins crossed the chaotic battlefield and fiercely penetrated the densely populated area behind the evil god army.

The human wanderers threw freely. They chewed dry food in their mouths and threw javelins one after another forward, killing a large number of the living forces of the evil god army.
